reconcileDrift: The completed local-data contract emits LocalDataIntegrationEvent.FirstRunNavigationRequired after a successful erase, but AppRootComponent has no typed reset entrypoint and the production graph cannot consume the event without bypassing Decompose navigation ownership.
goal: Add a typed, lifecycle-safe root navigation operation that atomically resets the Decompose stack to SCREEN-001 after successful local erase; test that prior destinations cannot reappear via Back and that state restoration starts from first run.
acceptanceCriteria: AppRootComponent exposes a typed resetToFirstRun operation owned by the root navigation boundary.
The default implementation dismisses any confirmation and replaces the entire stack with FIRST_RUN instead of pushing it.
Back cannot reveal pre-erase content after the reset, and serialization/restoration preserves the reset destination.
Preview implementation remains usable and contract tests cover compact and adaptive navigation invariants.
No data, Compose, platform, host, ledger, or external configuration changes; specialist does not run Gradle.
